title: ADA Camp: Igniting Change, Endless Possibilities
content: There's something magical about ADA Camp—where children living with diabetes can just be kids. Riding On Insulin welcomes those living with type 1 diabetes (ages 7-17) and their siblings or close friends to register for 1-day shred camps! All ability and experience levels accepted. Spending time at camp playing, skills-building, and making lifelong friendships is a rite of passage every child should experience. Exciting adventures, laughter, and unforgettable memories await ADA Camp and we want YOU to be part of the journey. Whether your child is new this year or a returning camper, our Camp Connections e-newsletter helps you stay informed, engaged, and connected with the community. Valuable independent diabetes management skills campers gain to build confidence Fun activities, like swimming, hiking, campfires, arts and crafts, and more Stay updated with the latest camp news, important announcements, additional ADA resources for children with or at risk for diabetes—including Project Power for youth and Safe at School ® —and more! Since 1949, the American Diabetes Association® (ADA) has connected children living with diabetes to adventure, education, mentors, and fun. Our overnight and day camps, and family retreats are led licensed medical staff trained in ADA's Standards of Care in Diabetes ; all ADA camps adhere to the highest standards, policies and procedures set forth by the American Camp Association, ensuring a safe, healthy, and fun experience! ADA Camp is a lifeline for children with diabetes to develop the critical skills needed to thrive while managing their diabetes. Attending camp helps children develop social skills, self-respect, and life-long friendships. Kids can meet others just like them while offering independence, building self-confidence, and gaining an awareness of a healthy lifestyle through education, nutrition, exercise, emotional well-being, and glucose management. ADA Camp offers a unique opportunity to make a lasting impact on the lives of children living with diabetes. Whether you're a licensed medical professional, student, or simply passionate about helping others, you'll be part of a team that empowers campers to learn independent diabetes management skills—all while having tons of fun! Camp positively impacts a wide-range of camper outcomes, including knowledge of diabetes management, management behaviors, confidence to manage diabetes, and emotional well-being. Help us deliver the magic of camp to every child. With generous support from camp sponsors—from families and individuals to corporate sponsors, community partners, foundations, clubs, and organizations—we can continue to serve thousands of children and their families. With your support, the American Diabetes Association® can continue our lifesaving work to make breakthroughs in research and provide people with the resources they need to fight diabetes.
